interpretation.authority: This is the single authoritative current Author task-evaluation artifact. Both imagined goals and source-derived results live together.
interpretation.operational_evidence: Source control witnesses prove declarations, not rendered interactions, completed configuration, or Save.
interpretation.task_catalog: Goals are explicit hypothetical author tasks for two game genres, not observed behavior
interpretation.graph: Routes and source-owner ownership come from the canonical source-derived navigation model
interpretation.cost: Only source-declared controls are counted. Conditional subtotals are NOT end-to-end costs, actual required clicks, subjective UX scores, or global minima.
interpretation.unknown: Absence of a captured static reference is not proof that the task is impossible, and unknown steps are not assigned artificial costs
interpretation.focus: Find misplaced/absent contextual routes and unexplained switches; context preservation is a separate contract, not a click minimization objective
interpretation.control_activations: Conditional ranges count only controls whose handlers are independently witnessed in the shared editor code for one intended adapter; not a measured full click path.
interpretation.authoring_operations: Individual response authoring operations trace concrete control and panel transitions, with non-additive conditional activation bounds; typing and full configuration remain outside source-only counts.
interpretation.delegated: Each task chooses its intended registered feature adapter using definition.resource_chain[].via. The lookup counts only that declared path; other adapters are available alternatives, not steps to perform. Source-described stages are not physical clicks.
interpretation.scene_media: Media art effects produce inline/overlay player presentation on Node entry, not a defined persistent background scene layer; these remain separate anticipated authoring goals.
